Subject:    Holtec International - Submittal of the Construction Permit Application
            for Pioneer Units 1 and 2

References: [1] 300-USNRC123 "Submittal of Pioneer Units 1 and 2 Limited Work
            Authorization Application (ADAMS Accession No. ML26009A012)

            [2] "Final Safety Evaluation for the 'Topical Report on the Quality Assurance
            Program for Holtec lnternational's Small Modular Reactor (SMR) Design
            and Construction' (EPID No. L-2023-TOP-0049)" (ADAMS Accession No.
            ML24228A060)

In accordance with the requirements of Title 10 of the Code of Federal Regulations (10
CFR) Part 50, SMR, LLC is pleased to submit, on behalf of Palisades SMR, LLC the
enclosed application requesting the US Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) review
and approve a Construction Permit (CP) for the construction of a dual-unit SMR-300
plant located at the Palisades Energy Center (PEC) in Covert, Michigan. The units are
individually named Pioneer Unit 1 and Pioneer Unit 2.

By letter dated December 31, 2025 (ML26009A012), SMR, LLC, a Holtec International
company, submitted the first part of a phased construction permit application to the U.S.
Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) for the proposed dual-unit SMR-300 facility at
the Palisades Energy Center (PEC) in Covert, Michigan. This submittal is the second
part (Part 2) of the construction permit application.

Enclosure I contains the proprietary version of the complete preliminary safety analysis
report (PSAR) to support the CPA and Enclosure II contains the corresponding non-
proprietary, redacted version. The application information has been prepared in
accordance with the applicable requirements of 10 CFR Part 50 and is consistent,
where applicable, with the format and content guidance provided in Regulatory Guide
1.206, "Applications for Nuclear Power Plants."



Transmittal No. 300-USNRC-26018                                   Page 1 of 3
                            Holtec Technology Campus, One Holtec Blvd, Camden, NJ 08104
                                                                Telephone (856) 797-0900
                                                                      Fax (856) 797-0909




 Enclosure Ill contains an updated version of the Quality Assurance Topical Report that
 was previously approved by the N RC staff [2]. Holtec requests review of this revised
 topical report to support the CPA.

 Enclosure IV contains a set of exemption requests which address aspects of the CPA
 that require exemption from the existing rules, with appropriate justification for each
 request.

 SMR respectfully requests that the NRC docket and review this Construction Permit
 Application. Enclosure V is provided in support of SMR's request to withhold proprietary
 information from public disclosure pursuant to 10 CFR 2.390.

 The Part 1 submittal [1] included the Environmental Report supporting the project, the
 site redress plan, and a proposed license condition related to funding sources. These
 items are unchanged with this Part 2 submittal. Similarly, the general and financial
 information submitted with the LWA is incorporated by reference into this Part 2 CP
 application. That information is currently under NRC review and any updates would
 apply equally to this application.

 If you have any questions or require any additional information, please contact Kimberly
 Manzione, Executive Director of Licensing and Regulatory Affairs,
 k.manzione@holtec.com or 856-797-0900 ext. 3951.

 I declare under penalty of perjury that the foregoing is true and correct. Executed on
 September 30, 2026.
